review_scope: Read-only frozen candidate transport and exact-support integration versus original repository sources; no observations or holdout accessed.
verified_contracts: Primary matching capacities are strict in greedy initialization and augmenting edges. Source HW exact cuts sum to source capacity, so correctly-rounded parcel height equals that representable capacity.
Fallback invokes only on public PlacementError. The radius2/3 parent-target stencil, outgoing/incoming accounting and donor continuation are unchanged.

Fallback source capacity uses every grouped lengths term, emits one allocation share per actual source/destination arc, and one physical child per contiguous sourcePart/destination intersection. Binary residual terms do not acquire independent constitutive histories.
Fallback child flow integrates each retained child rectangle at its original local top; destination-local offset compensation preserves its represented physical centroid.

Primary and fallback destination padding use exact unoccupied units; footwall parts are retained. Full-domain projection guards are applied at both raster sites, with no subsequent primitive/subcell override.
The normal shear retains its integer heave/direction, side/top/bottom accounting, source donor and transfer-provenance contracts. Exact cuts use common fault-depth differences.
Layer.height mutation sites preserve grouped support on identity/translation and replace it only when compaction actually changes height.
No forcing, random draw, metric, eligibility, or holdout changes were made by this review.
explicit_limits: This is a bounded discrete packet transport model, not a geometric polygon-overlap finite-volume remap.
Capacity fallback minimizes quantized parent-target squared displacement per unit bulk within the existing stencil. Child-specific flow targets are reconstructed after allocation, not reoptimized.
Fallback orders children by represented physical centers in a destination; it does not prove a continuous, globally noninterpenetrating material geometry.
Fault HW classification, incoming ghost continuation, erosion/deposition accommodation and observational profile extraction retain their existing storage-coordinate approximation.
Exact support decides topology and conservation of interval ownership; constitutive laws, grains, positions and physical moments remain floating-point quantities.
Full36 development comparison and the full existing test suite were running at review time. Pilot closure and analytical tests are not claims of universal convergence improvement.
